query:
SELECT o.date AS "date!: NaiveDate", SUM(o.amount_cents) AS "amount!: i64"
           FROM operation o
           JOIN account a ON a.id = o.account_id
           WHERE a.archived = 0 AND a.type IN ('CHECKING', 'SAVINGS', 'CREDIT_CARD')
             AND o.date <= ?1
           GROUP BY o.date
